caseNameFull: Presley v. Etowah County Commission and Mack v. Russell County Commission

opinions.text: D. C. M. D. Ala. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 500 U. S. 914.] Motion of NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of ap-pellee Etowah County Commission for divided argument denied. Motion of appellee Russell County Commission for divided argument denied.
